text.lede: I set competition pieces from solos to big groups, teach dancers from five years old to adult, and build the costumes too.
text.hat1_p: Musical theatre, jazz, contemporary and lyrical, from a solo to a full company number. My duet Stepsisters Lament won the Judges Award, "Broadway Bound," at StarQuest Nationals.
text.hat2_p: I lead Technique & Flexibility for ages 5 to 9 at DWD ProSeries, and teach jazz, musical theatre, acro and contemporary up through elite competition dancers and adult beginners.
text.hat3_p: Years on the Celebration Arts Academy competition team, a scholarship at nationals, and a season with ASH The Company. Now I coach the dancers coming up behind me.
text.work_p: Competition pieces I choreographed, with the dancers who brought them to the stage.
text.teach_p: Every class gets warmed up properly, pushed honestly and sent home a little better. The littles leave with their splits closer. The big kids leave with a combo they want to film.
text.stage_p: Before I set pieces, I danced them. Tokyo Sunrise, The Moment I Said It, Strange Thunder, Be Glad, One Eye Open and more, on the Celebration Arts Academy competition team.
text.costume_p: I design, source and rhinestone costumes, and I plan the hair, makeup and jewelry so a team reads as one. I am the costume lead for DWD ProSeries this season, and I built the costumes for Stepsisters Lament myself.
text.contact_h: Let's make something for your dancers.
text.references: Dixon Bowles, Founder and Director, Dance With Dixon. Available on request.
